scope: Corrects single-day diagnostic identity aggregation only. No replay outcome, reward, PnL, markout, Validation, or sealed holdout was read or regenerated.
root_causes: The report compared one evaluated equivalence day with all three frozen formal equivalence days, so the single-day diagnostic subset was falsely marked non-equivalent even though its checkpoint passed.
The diagnostic --skip-source-rehash branch replaced the frozen market manifest identity with an empty list, so the report emitted rows=0 instead of an explicit not-rehashed identity reference.

corrected_contract.diagnostic_control_equivalence: Require only frozen equivalence days that are present in the evaluated diagnostic subset; emit null when the subset contains no frozen equivalence day.
corrected_contract.formal_control_equivalence: A full Development run still requires all frozen equivalence days and fails when any required day is missing or unequal.
corrected_contract.diagnostic_market_identity: Retain the frozen canonical SHA256, row count, and byte count while emitting rehash_performed=false and entries_materialized=false.
corrected_contract.formal_market_identity: Rebuild and hash all entries, then require canonical SHA256, row count, and byte count to match the frozen identity.

future_execution_rule: The patched evaluator must not be represented by the frozen v1.1 implementation hash. Before any future smoke or formal Development execution, create a separate executable v1.2 spec with current implementation and test-artifact hashes.
